prompt: Repaint this exact fantasy game world map at blue twilight, keeping every road, path, crossroads clearing, lake, stream and the ice fortress exactly where they are with the same shapes (do not move, add or remove any road). Same flat vector cel-shaded style with thick clean outlines, top-down three-quarter view. No text, characters or UI.
